authorization.scope: Only this release, the exact reviewed rc.1 cohort (root peer closure plus the single runtime/host test trees), and the one stated report graph; not a security fix or low-probability assurance. The upstream Zod gap remains unfixed and is accepted as a known issue for this candidate.

audited_scope: Root package-lock npm production and full scans against the exact 0.8.0 peer closure (18 affected packages, one graph). The rc.1 runtime tree resolves a single top-level zod 4.4.3; the rc.1 host tree resolves top-level zod 4.6.7 (patched) alongside exact-pinned nested 4.4.3 copies declared by the upstream packages themselves. Neither tree is separately scanned by this gate; their locks bind the reviewed cohort. No exception for a new advisory, unreviewed graph or another dependency tree.
prerequisite: Large invalid arrays can exhaust memory during affected schema validation. Reachability through a DSH entry point and ordinary-use likelihood are not established. The dependency path runs through @deepseek-ai/dsh-commands and @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm (and @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent), which pin zod 4.4.3 exactly; the fix must come from the upstream DSH release family.
